name: samvaad-mom-generator
description: SAMVAAD — Real-time Meeting Transcription & MOM Generator

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.dev:browser: concurrently -n AI,BACKEND,VITE -c green,cyan,blue "cd services/ai && .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -u main.py" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run build:dev"
scripts.dev:mac: concurrently -n AI,BACKEND,VITE -c green,cyan,blue "cd services/ai && ./venv/bin/python -u main.py" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run build:dev"
scripts.clean: echo Cleaning background tasks... && taskkill /F /FI "IMAGENAME eq node.exe" /FI "PID ne 0" /T || exit 0
